name: workflow
description: Engineering guidance for planning, specifications, tickets, implementation, debugging, review, and ledger-backed execution.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, specify, implement, review, and execute engineering work.
interface.longDescription: Move engineering work from brainstorming through specifications, plans, and tickets. Execute authorized changes with proportional test-first implementation, systematic debugging, focused review, and minimal code. Use external branch task ledgers for one bounded implementation, review, and commit cycle per task. Consult the field guide for durable local guidance.
defaultPrompt: Use $workflow:coordinator to route planning, investigation, authorized implementation, and named-ticket end-to-end execution.
Use the planning and writing skills for brainstorming, specifications, plans, ticket decomposition, ticket writing, PR descriptions, and technical prose.
Use $workflow:implementation for proportional test-first evidence with $workflow:minimal-code, and use $workflow:systematic-debugging for failures and unexpected behavior.
Use $workflow:receiving-code-review to verify review feedback and $workflow:review-cycle to accept the final diff and evidence.
Use $workflow:agent-walkthrough for a staff-level branch walkthrough when named-work-item end-to-end work has branch-level integration risk.
Use $workflow:branch-task-planner when explicitly requested or when named-ticket end-to-end execution requires an external ledger.
Use $workflow:field-guide to consult and capture durable guidance, and use $workflow:simplification-review for focused, read-only cleanup audits.
